message.content: According to the conversation on May 21st, 2026, ChaeSong-hwa suggested playing "The Yellow Wind Rises" and "To the West" on Sunday as part of a jam session. He expressed enthusiasm for these songs, stating that he was looking forward to seeing how they would go together. However, it's important to note that the group ultimately decided to stick to the original plan of playing "The Yellow Wind Rises" and "To the West," rather than adding more upbeat songs as suggested by YurikoYamamoto.
